decisionsTitle: The members' texts translate in one press, and their two languages are tabs «RO» | «EN»
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-09-29 20:50, with a screenshot of «Pagini» → «Membri» → «Scrie zona membrilor»:** «În zona de membri, butonul de traducere nu merge, și partea bilingvă trebuie să fie per tabs.» The Romanian editor held «Salutare colegii!», the English one was empty, the save was refused naming «Zona membrilor (engleză)» (§352), and «Copiază și tradu tot: RO → EN» (§482) answered «Nu e nimic de tradus: scrie întâi textele în română.»

**Why the press found nothing.** It never read a stale value: it reads every box by name at the moment it is pressed, a rich text through the hidden box its editor keeps in step (§464). But it fills only the English boxes on its allowlist (`translate/domain/fields.ts`, §482), and «Membri»'s two texts (§524) post `benefitsRoBody` / `benefitsEnBody` and `zoneRoBody` / `zoneEnBody`, names added after the list was written and never put on it. With no English box it was allowed to fill, the press said there was nothing to translate. Both names are on the list now, as rich texts with their Romanian twin found by the `…RoBody` / `…EnBody` spelling «Echipa» already uses. The server checks names against the same list, so it now accepts them as well. The translation arrives in the English editor as content, through the same fill event the other editors use.

**Decision: tabs «RO» | «EN» in one card.** The two editors of each members' text sit in one `LocaleTabPanels` strip inside its fold, the same strip the event editor, the standing pages, the album form and «Întrebări frecvente» already use (§350), with one editor on screen at a time. The other language's editor stays mounted and hidden, so the save still posts both languages (§352). The tabs read «RO» and «EN». The English one says «nescris încă» («not written yet») while its editor is empty, re-read as the person types (§350). The strip learnt to watch names spelt `zone{Locale}Body` as well as `translations.<locale>.<field>`. «Copiază și tradu tot» stays above the tabs, visible whichever tab is on top (§482). A refusal naming the English box brings the English tab forward with the box it names, through the reveal every strip already answers (§47, §350).

**After a translate press.** Every strip whose English panel holds a box the press filled, in the form that pressed, brings the English tab forward. This works for «Copiază și tradu tot» and for a card's own «Tradu cardul» (§514), because the press announces the names it filled and each strip checks its own English panel. A translation hidden behind the Romanian tab is one nobody reads before «Salvează». Where the strip is given the word, as on «Membri», the English tab also says «tradus — verifică» («translated — check it») until the person types, pastes or deletes there (`beforeinput`, which a fill does not fire). This applies to every strip, so after «Copiază și tradu tot» on the event editor, a standing page or the FAQ the strips holding filled boxes also show their English. The mark itself is only on «Membri» for now.

**The language glyph on every tab.** Each language tab, on every strip, carries the flag the header's language switcher shows beside the language's name or code (Romania for Romanian, the United Kingdom for English). It is never the label: the image is `alt=""` and the tab's name stays the words (§521, the owner's glyph rule). The map moved from `LocaleSwitcher` to `Flag.tsx` (`LANGUAGE_FLAG`) so both read one list. Below `sm` the tabs are a little narrower to make room for it. At 320 px «RO» and «EN · nescris încă» fit on one row. With both languages empty the row scrolls sideways (the strip's own behaviour) rather than wrapping.

**One fold across the tabs.** A rich text's fold inside a strip is twinned with its other-language fold (§363). The twin key now also removes the language from the `…RoBody` / `…EnBody` spelling (`zone*Body`), so the members' text opened under «RO» is also open under «EN». The same now holds for «Echipa»'s and the FAQ's rich texts.

**Screens that change:** «Membri» (both texts: tabs, marks, the press). Every strip gets the flags and the English tab after a press. **Not changed:** «Echipa»'s cards, which already had their own strips, and the newsletter composer. No dependency and no migration.
changelogLine: - **«Membri»: «Copiază și tradu tot» translates the members' texts, and their two languages are tabs «RO» | «EN»** — the press knows «Beneficiile membrilor» and the members' zone, so it no longer answers «Nu e nimic de tradus» over Romanian already written. One editor is on screen at a time, the English tab says «nescris încă» while empty and comes forward after a translation marked «tradus — verifică», and a refused save shows the English tab. Every language tab in the backoffice carries the header's flag. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: On «Membri», with «Beneficiile membrilor» or the members' zone written in Romanian and its English empty, «Copiază și tradu tot: RO → EN» translates it in one press and the English editor shows the translation. It reads the Romanian as typed at the moment of the press, and says «Nu e nimic de tradus» only when that Romanian is empty. `benefitsEnBody` and `zoneEnBody` are on the translate allowlist as rich texts, with `benefitsRoBody` / `zoneRoBody` as their twins (2026-09-30, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Each members' text shows its two editors as tabs «RO» | «EN» in one strip, one editor at a time, with «Copiază și tradu tot» above the tabs. The hidden language's editor stays in the form, so the save posts both. Each tab carries the header's flag beside its code, the flag never being the tab's name. The English tab reads «nescris încă» («not written yet») while its editor is empty, re-read as the person types (2026-09-30, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

After a translate press fills a box in a strip's English panel, in the form that pressed, that strip brings its English tab forward. A strip in another form, or one whose English holds no filled box, stays as it was. On «Membri» the English tab reads «tradus — verifică» («translated — check it») until the person types in it (2026-09-30, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A members' text saved with its Romanian alone is refused on its English box. The refusal names «Zona membrilor (engleză)» (or the benefits' English) and brings the English tab forward. Saved with both languages, the translated English is stored as posted, and saved with neither the text is emptied. Only the Redactor and the Administrator may write (2026-09-30, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the members' texts translate in one press, and their languages are tabs «RO» | «EN»
